rewrites.comment: Client-side routing: React Router owns every path, so anything that is not a real file or an API route must serve the app shell. Without this, refreshing on /markets returns a 404. Rewrites run after the filesystem check, so hashed assets and /api routes are unaffected.

headers.comment: Vite fingerprints these filenames, so they can be cached forever.
The shell must never be cached, or a deploy serves stale asset links.
